comparison.objective: Torque multiple bolts in a star pattern; candidate iteratively tunes one damper and locks its setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequenced bolt engagement and torque application differs from counterholding, unlocking a collar, response-guided fine adjustment, relocking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Correct star order and bolt torque versus two ≥0.85 J non-bottoming stops, acceptable rebound, and low drift. Record has no body/spec rubric.
comparison.reason: Shared force-limited tightening is only one generic primitive; the candidate chiefly tests dynamic tuning and retention rather than multi-fastener torque sequencing.
